title.narrative: Improving Marine Monitoring Along the Aqaba Coastline

description.narrative: The UNDP project aims to improve marine monitoring and biodiversity conservation along Jordan’s Gulf of Aqaba, a critical marine ecosystem facing threats from pollution, overfishing, and tourism. By partnering with Norway’s Institute of Marine Research, the project will enhance local capacities, introduce advanced monitoring techniques, and strengthen the sustainable management of Aqaba’s marine resources. This initiative fosters collaboration between local authorities, researchers, and communities to protect coral reefs and marine biodiversity while promoting sustainable livelihoods and scientific innovation.
